# Altruva Aesthetic & Regenerative Clinic

Altruva is a premier regenerative and aesthetic clinic based in Jakarta, Indonesia. Specializing in advanced, non-invasive procedures led by dr. Olivia Aldisa.

## Information Resources

- [Home](https://altruva.co.id/) - Official homepage with medical services, brand vision, and values.
- [Services & Treatments](https://altruva.co.id/treatments) - Comprehensive non-invasive treatments including Sofwave, EmSculpt Neo, Gouri, and regenerative aesthetic therapies.
- [Skin Analysis](https://altruva.co.id/skin-analysis) - AI-powered skin analysis and personalized treatment planning.
- [Blog](https://altruva.co.id/blog) - Medical insights, skincare updates, perimenopause education, and clinic news.
- [Beauty Journal](https://altruva.co.id/beauty-journal) - Clinical case studies and treatment deep-dives.
- [Book Appointment](https://altruva.co.id/book-appointment) - Real-time schedule booking and consultation appointments with medical professionals.
- [About Meet the Doctor](https://altruva.co.id/about/meet-dr-olivia-aldisa) - Professional profile of founder dr. Olivia Aldisa and clinical background.
- [About Our Clinic](https://altruva.co.id/our-clinic) - Clinic facilities, philosophy, and patient experience.
- [Contact](https://altruva.co.id/contact) - Clinic location, hours, and contact information.
- [FAQ](https://altruva.co.id/faq) - Frequently asked questions about treatments and procedures.
- [Gallery](https://altruva.co.id/gallery) - Before/after treatment results and clinic gallery.
- [News & Media](https://altruva.co.id/news-media) - Press coverage, media features, and clinic announcements.

## Technical Details

- **Technology Stack**: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI primitives.
- **CMS Platform**: Secure custom admin panel for managing dynamic articles, keywords, metadata, and blog formatting.
- **Content Delivery**: Google Cloud Storage (GCS) for optimized medical imagery and responsive asset delivery.
